BiblicalUsage: Hachmoni is a family name among David's mighty men — Jashobeam the Hachmonite, chief of the captains, and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni, who was with the king's sons. Two men carry it, and both stood close to the king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a family name among mighty men is a place of honour: the Hachmonites stood beside the king and beside his sons.
RelatedPeople: King David; Jashobeam, Son of Zabdiel
